# Fault tree

`customer_support.df.root_cause_analysis.fault_tree` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Fault tree analysis — start from the undesired outcome and decompose into the combinations of conditions that could produce it, then eliminate branches with evidence.

Handles the branching and multi-cause structure that Five Whys cannot express, and makes the unexamined branches visible so an investigation can be reviewed for what it did not check. Expensive; earn it on high-severity or recurring issues.
